entries.label: ui.settings.software.audio_decoding
entries.aliases: 音频解码方式 通用设置 软件配置 完整缓存（默认） 流式解码 完整缓存：加载时解码整段音频，跳转和重复播放稳定；长音频占用更多内存，首次加载较慢。 流式解码：后台分块预读，PCM 内存有界、启动较快；播放时持续解码，远距离跳转或预读不足可能短暂静音。 重新加载项目或试听音频后生效。波形分析、音效和资源级离线处理仍使用完整缓存。 Audio Decoding General Settings Software Config Full cache (default) Streaming Full cache: decodes the entire file before use for stable seeking and replay; longer audio uses more memory and takes longer to load. Streaming: prefetches PCM blocks with bounded memory and faster startup; continuous decoding, distant seeks or underruns may cause brief silence. Applies when reloading a project or audition audio. Waveform analysis, sound effects and offline resource processing still use full caching.
